title: AI Will Draw The Person You’ll Marry
summary: Explore attraction, personality and everyday-life preferences, then reveal a fictional partner portrait matched to your answers.

landing.intro: Follow the clues. Reveal the portrait matched to your heart.

about.body:
Explore attraction, personality, everyday life and the little things that make a connection feel right. There are ten themed stages of eight questions, with no right or wrong answers. The opening choice sets the portrait presentation; the other choices contribute to your relationship-style match.

Choose your first answer, watch a short ad, then continue to question two. Each checkpoint introduces a fresh topic, while the finished portrait stays hidden until the final reveal. Your progress is saved on this device.

Your answers select a result from an original library of fictional portraits. The image is not drawn live, based on a real person or a prediction of whom you will marry. This is an entertainment experience, not a psychological or relationship assessment.

steps: Choose the portrait presentation. A short ad follows your first answer.
Answer each set of eight questions, then continue after the checkpoint ad.
Reveal your fictional partner portrait and relationship style. Explore your preferences in more detail after an optional extra ad.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This quiz matches your preferences to an original fictional portrait and relationship archetype. It does not identify a real person or predict an actual relationship or marriage.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your first impressions have set the direction. Next, go beyond the look and discover the personality you are drawn to.

next.tagline: A look catches your eye. What makes someone stay on your mind?

stage-2.preAdTitle: Now there is personality behind the portrait
stage-2.preAdCopy: Humour, trust and support have added another layer. Now picture the everyday life you would want to share.

next.tagline: Picture a Saturday, a shared home and the life between big moments.

stage-3.preAdTitle: You have pictured a life together
stage-3.preAdCopy: Your choices say more than a dream date could. Next, explore the kind of connection that makes ordinary moments matter.

next.tagline: What turns a good match into a connection you can feel?

stage-4.preAdTitle: Your connection has a clearer shape
stage-4.preAdCopy: You have explored affection and how you reconnect. Change the pace now: choose the places, colours and little clues that call to you.

next.tagline: No perfect answers here. Follow the places and details that pull you in.

stage-5.preAdTitle: Your instincts have joined the picture
stage-5.preAdCopy: The dreamy details are in. Now bring the portrait down to earth with the tiny gestures that make you feel chosen.

next.tagline: A message, a small favour, a shared laugh. Which little things matter?

stage-6.preAdTitle: The small details say a lot
stage-6.preAdCopy: You have shown what makes care feel personal. Next, explore the space a relationship needs for both people to grow.

next.tagline: Two people, two lives. What helps you grow without losing yourself?

stage-7.preAdTitle: A strong connection needs room to grow
stage-7.preAdCopy: You have explored independence, encouragement and being yourself. Now see what happens when the plan changes.

next.tagline: Missed trains and changed plans can reveal an unexpected side of a match.

stage-8.preAdTitle: You have seen beyond the perfect date
stage-8.preAdCopy: The way you handle a detour adds another side to your match. Next, choose the moments you would want to turn into traditions.

next.tagline: Which ordinary moments would you want to repeat for years?

stage-9.preAdTitle: Your shared story has its own feel
stage-9.preAdCopy: Your everyday rituals and favourite memories have added the finishing touches. One final set of instinctive choices leads to the portrait reveal.

next.tagline: The final clues: choose what feels right, then meet your fictional match.

stage-10.preAdCopy: Your attraction, everyday-life choices and final instincts are all in. Reveal your fictional portrait, their relationship style and the details behind your match.

warm_anchor.title: The Warm Anchor
warm_anchor.copy: You are drawn to someone whose steadiness feels like relief, never routine. This match makes space for honesty, brings warmth to ordinary moments and helps the relationship feel safe enough to grow.

playful_spark.title: The Playful Spark
playful_spark.copy: Your match brings lightness without avoiding the serious stuff. The chemistry grows through private jokes, spontaneous plans and the feeling that even an ordinary evening can become a favourite memory.

quiet_creative.title: The Quiet Creative
quiet_creative.copy: You are matched with someone who notices what other people miss. Their imagination, calm originality and understated confidence create a connection that deepens slowly and keeps revealing new layers.

grounded_builder.title: The Grounded Builder
grounded_builder.copy: Your future works best with someone who turns care into action. They bring patience, reliability and practical optimism, creating the kind of partnership where plans become real without losing their warmth.

magnetic_connector.title: The Magnetic Connector
magnetic_connector.copy: You are drawn to someone who makes people feel seen. Their social confidence comes with real emotional awareness, so the attraction feels exciting while the relationship still has generosity and depth.

curious_explorer.title: The Curious Explorer
curious_explorer.copy: Your match sees life as something to discover together. They bring energy, independence and genuine curiosity, making the relationship feel spacious enough for adventure and close enough to feel like home.

thoughtful_dreamer.title: The Thoughtful Dreamer
thoughtful_dreamer.copy: You are matched with someone who brings tenderness and imagination to the connection. They listen closely, remember the small things and make shared hopes feel emotionally rich rather than unrealistic.

ambitious_teammate.title: The Ambitious Teammate
ambitious_teammate.copy: Your strongest match wants a relationship that moves forward together. Their drive is balanced by loyalty and encouragement, turning two separate ambitions into the feeling of being on the same team.
ambitious_teammate.firstFeature: their confident posture and direct gaze.
